scientific_limitations: The exact sharp first-entry and period theorem requires precisely one absent color on one shore and all q colors on the other. The alternating-wave census counts only that specified recurrent family, not all possible orbits. The conditional limit fixes q as n increases. Inaccessible original 1995 and related 1997 full text create residual historical equivalence risk; independent review has not occurred.
title: Parity-selected oscillatory waves from a single missing color in cyclic graph dynamics
